title: Observability: set_aad/get_tag/set_tag/key_export_public silent on callback failure
description: set_aad, get_tag, set_tag (crypto2dev_fd.c lines ~977, 1014, 1063) and key_export_public in read() (~line 533) have no pr_err on callback failure. A support engineer seeing -EINVAL or -EIO from SET_AAD/GET_TAG/SET_TAG or from read() on a KEY fd cannot determine from dmesg what the provider returned or why — the only log is the kernel errno returned to userspace with no context.
